reason_classes.hazard: Risk transfer continues while liquidity is below the candidate floor and the mark/oracle gap is material.
reason_classes.hardening: Fail-closed oracle-gap/liquidity guard must block payout-bearing transitions before this can be treated as non-disaster evidence.
reason_classes.proof_target: If liquidity < floor and abs(mark/oracle - 1) > gap_bound, accepted payout and liquidation transitions are zero or rejected.

reason_classes.hazard: A payout cap tied to current insurance can exceed the initial epoch budget after fee accrual.
reason_classes.hardening: Payout caps must bind to an explicit epoch budget, not inflated current insurance.
reason_classes.proof_target: For every accepted payout transition, payout <= payout_cap_share * initial_epoch_insurance_budget.

reason_classes.hazard: Funding remains high while executable liquidity is thin.
reason_classes.hardening: Thin-liquidity funding clamp must reduce absolute funding before risk transfer is accepted.

reason_classes.hazard: Insurance can become negative under accepted stress transitions.
reason_classes.hardening: Budget caps and fail-closed guards should keep this unreachable in bounded scout runs.
reason_classes.proof_target: Insurance balance remains nonnegative under accepted bounded transitions.

reason_classes.hazard: Fee burn consumes more than the allowed budget share.
reason_classes.hardening: Legal-shape gate must cap burn plus insurance shares before promotion.
reason_classes.proof_target: Burn share stays below the configured maximum for every accepted fee transition.

reason_classes.hazard: A scout run emits a new disaster reason that is not mapped to a tracked hardening or proof target.
reason_classes.hardening: The regression gate must reject any unclassified reason before the run can become evidence.
reason_classes.proof_target: Every emitted counterexample reason is a member of the tracked reason-class manifest.

reason_classes.hazard: A candidate is promoted despite nonzero disaster rate, illegal shape, underfunded insurance, or excessive guard reliance.
reason_classes.hardening: Promotion candidates must pass strict no-disaster, legal-shape, insurance, and guard-use filters.
reason_classes.proof_target: Every promotion candidate satisfies the strict candidate predicate checked by the regression gate.

reason_classes.hazard: A witness-space receipt is treated as authoritative while gate-critical checker or atlas files are dirty.
reason_classes.hardening: Use --require-clean for release evidence and reject receipts with gate-critical dirty paths.
reason_classes.proof_target: A release-bound witness-space receipt has no dirty gate-critical checker, manifest, or atlas paths.
